title: Shannon's theorem on edge colourings of multigraphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Shannon's theorem (1949): every finite loopless multigraph of maximum degree at most Δ has a proper edge colouring with ⌊3Δ/2⌋ colours; and its sharpness: for every Δ the Shannon triangle (three vertices with ⌊Δ/2⌋, ⌊Δ/2⌋ and ⌈Δ/2⌉ parallel edges between the three pairs) has maximum degree at most Δ and no proper edge colouring with fewer than ⌊3Δ/2⌋ colours. Multigraphs are edge families ends : ι → V × V (parallel edges allowed), a lighter representation than Mathlib's multigraph structure Graph α β (Mathlib.Combinatorics.Graph.Basic: vertex and edge sets with an incidence relation IsLink), which at the pinned revision has no degrees or edge colourings; no bridge to Graph α β is proved. Neither result is in Mathlib.
